sloka: जीवति अपि महा राजे तव एव वचनम् वयम् ।न अतिक्रमामहे सर्वे वेलाम् प्राप्य इव सागरः ॥२-६७-३७॥
transliteration: jīvati api mahā rāje tava eva vacanam vayam ।na atikramāmahe sarve velām prāpya iva sāgaraḥ ॥2-67-37॥

translations.english: Even while the great king was alive, we never defied your word like the ocean which does not overstep its shore.
